# Shazam

> > Shazam is a music discovery and identification platform providing comprehensive album catalogs, artist discographies, and song metadata across all genres worldwide.

Shazam enables users to identify, discover, and explore music through its extensive database of albums, tracks, and artist information. The platform covers diverse musical genres from hip-hop and electronic music to traditional folk, classical, and international releases.

## Key Topics

- Music identification and discovery
- Album tracklists and metadata
- Artist discographies
- Electronic music and synthwave
- Hip-hop albums and releases
- International music catalogs
- Turkish art music
- Bluegrass and country music
- French pop and children's music
- German schlager
- Hardcore and darksynth genres
- 2015-2017 music releases
- Compilation albums
- Independent record labels
- Music streaming integration

## Hip-Hop & Rap Albums

- [Village Party 2: Heaven's Gate - album by Alex Wiley](https://www.shazam.com/album/1048313229/village-party-2-heavens-gate): Alex Wiley's 2015 hip-hop album 'Village Party 2: Heaven's Gate'

## Electronic & Synthwave Music

- [The Uncanny Valley - album by Perturbator](https://www.shazam.com/album/1093276294/the-uncanny-valley): Perturbator's 2016 darksynth album 'The Uncanny Valley' on Blood Music
- [The Uncanny Valley (Expansion) - album by Perturbator](https://www.shazam.com/album/1094501104/the-uncanny-valley-expansion): Perturbator's 'Uncanny Valley' expansion with instrumental versions (2016)
- [The Raven - Single - album by The Avengerz](https://www.shazam.com/album/1088365951/the-raven-single): The Avengerz hardcore single 'The Raven' feat. Thyron (2016)

## Country & Bluegrass Albums

- [American Grandstand - album by Rhonda Vincent](https://www.shazam.com/album/1242744360/american-grandstand): Rhonda Vincent's 2017 bluegrass album feat. Daryle Singletary

## International & World Music

- [Taş Plak Nostalji Serisi, Vol. 6 (Türk Sanat Müziği) - album by](https://www.shazam.com/album/1077374906/ta%C5%9F-plak-nostalji-serisi-vol-6-t%C3%BCrk-sanat-m%C3%BCzi%C4%9Fi): Turkish art music compilation Vol. 6 by Odeon Müzikçilik Yapımcılık
- [Frauen - album by Mario & Christoph](https://www.shazam.com/album/1104232600/frauen): Mario & Christoph's 2016 German schlager album 'Frauen'
- [Weihnachten in Tirol - A besondere Zeit - album by Mario & Christoph](https://www.shazam.com/album/1167693440/weihnachten-in-tirol-a-besondere-zeit): Mario & Christoph's 2016 Tyrolean Christmas album with Alexander Rier
- [Plateau télé - album by Aldebert](https://www.shazam.com/album/1174368110/plateau-t%C3%A9l%C3%A9): Aldebert's 2004 French pop album 'Plateau télé' on Note A Bene
